title: Coleman OneSource Rechargeable Heated Seat Cushion

comparisons.notes: Coleman OneSource Heated Stadium Seat & Rechargeable Battery, MFG Part No. 2000037459 (same MPN as the Woot item); 4800mAh battery, 4 heat settings; in stock, free shipping.

writeup: Coleman's OneSource heated stadium seat (MPN 2000037459) is down to $44.99 on Woot, while Camping World lists the same seat and battery kit at $139.99. It has four heat settings and a 4800mAh rechargeable battery that can also charge your phone, which makes it a handy pick for cold bleachers and tailgates. Woot shows only a few left with a limit of 3 per customer.
